$comment: Command Governor project settings for Prime Agent: copy to
<project>/.prime/agent/settings.json (or merge into it). Prime installs
any missing package on startup. Versions here MUST equal pins/pins.json
packages[].exactVersion; the conformance suite compares them.
Deliberately absent, with the measured reason (2026-09-04):
pi-squad         does not load on Prime (pi-ai/compat alias) and ends
tasks only on agent_settled, which Prime never emits
pi-subagents     does not load on Prime (same alias); superseded by
@gotgenes/pi-subagents, which registers the same
`subagent` tool name, so the two must never coexist
pi-governance-pipeline  loads, but wants to own AGENTS.md/SOUL.md/
SYSTEM.md/MEMORY.md and its shell half hardcodes `pi`
pi-oracle        does not load on Prime until its compatibility patch
lands upstream (docs/upstream/)
pi-gpt           vendored: installed by path from pins/packages/ (relative
to this file's directory, <project>/.prime/agent/), which is
this repository as the project; another project installs it
with `prime-agent package install --local <repo>/pins/packages/pi-gpt-0.4.3`
@gotgenes/pi-permission-system  does not load on Prime and cannot see
kernel-side bash() even when patched
pi-observational-memory / pi-continual-harness  not baked; Prime's
continual harness is the default memory owner
